scientific_definition.black_trace: Black trace scientific draft change: B is median eligible raw baseline frames in [-15,0); raw frame V-B is scaled using P10/P90 of unbinned baseline-frame raw deviations; no logarithm. No trace, baseline or scaling binning/smoothing. Shared display y limits [0,5]; baseline zero at bottom; 230 upper and 28789 lower frame values visually clipped, numerical values unchanged. Colour bands copy the corresponding exact selected F rows (values and rendered RGB), with F cadence timing and baseline-bin normalization preserved. Black trace timing remains measured D time.

bands.missing: NaN black; entire trial undefined without baseline data
bands.timing: established camera cadence reconstruction; not measured AbsoluteTime reanalysis

readiness_policy: Panel status describes first-release readiness. Existing scoped author freezes are recorded separately and do not imply approval of a whole assembly or unresolved release gates.
current_definition_policy: Latest explicit accepted freeze within each panel scope defines the current version. Superseded recipes are legacy; panels without an accepted freeze are proposed. Release readiness is tracked separately.
